build_status_note: PARTIAL BY DECLARATION, not by failure: 148 object(s) could not be resolved from the pinned inputs and were REFUSED and registered rather than defaulted. A fallback always produces a row, so it never produces an error; each register entry is the error a fallback would have hidden. Every other object was built.
tree_digest_recipe: per file: posix-relpath + LF + sha256(bytes); lines sorted bytewise, joined by LF, sha256 of the UTF-8 join

rule_application.satellites_split_note: 0 by construction AND re-counted from the emitted SQL by verify_hcon4.py check 1, which reads each satellite's own ref() list rather than trusting the generator.
rule_application.hash_site_note: One per central view, and nowhere else. Verified by check 4, which searches every model for an md5( call outside the stage layer.

map_coverage.reference_satellites_note: data_7.js carries reference satellites and this map's target track names NONE of them, so no vault/refs layer is written. An empty directory would advertise a layer that does not exist; this is the gap, and it is an item for the modeller.
map_coverage.key_slot_note: Key slots come from TWO sources -- resolved_key in the map, and the legacy half's forms recovered read-only from health_dv_dbt's emitted SQL. Sweeping only the map reported 5 hubs as keyed nowhere and would have refused 8 satellites and 18 links on a false zero. The correction is recorded because the figure was already reported once before it was caught.

verification.four_outcomes_note: Each check reports PASS, FAIL, NOT RUN or DID NOT COMPLETE with the population it ran over. A PASS over an empty population is downgraded to NOT RUN, because a zero from a probe that looked in the wrong place is indistinguishable from a clean result.

other_builds_unchanged.detail: every file in 22 sibling project(s) plus vault_tools was checked for a modification time at or after this project's own oldest file (22357 files scanned). Content digests are also recorded now, so a later run can compare bytes as well -- but on THIS run mtime is the only evidence that exists, because no pre-work baseline was captured.

corrections.what_was_reported: 5 model hubs keyed nowhere in the map, refusing 8 satellites and 18 links
corrections.why_it_was_wrong: Key slots come from TWO sources: resolved_key in the map, which the profile measures as present on zero legacy rows, and the legacy half's forms recovered read-only from health_dv_dbt's emitted SQL. The first pass swept only the map. All five hubs are keyed on the legacy half.
corrections.class: a zero from a probe that looked in one of two places, which is indistinguishable from a clean result
corrections.fixed_in: hcon4_plan.key_slots / hub_key_tables, which now sweep both sources and raise if the legacy recovery fails rather than silently refusing

cross_build_facts_cited_in_prose.note: Figures from earlier builds in this estate, recorded here so the handback and the model headers can cite them rather than typing them into prose. They describe OTHER builds and are not state of this one.

known_open_items.item: BUILD_RULES.md s6 contradicts the governing rule
known_open_items.detail: s6 calls its per-source-table architecture 'Invariant across every build' and mandates one cast per mapped view, one wide stage per view, and satellites unioned over all feeders. Under the central-view rule a satellite has ONE feeder by construction. Both cannot hold. This build did NOT edit s6 -- a build does not rewrite the law it is judged by.

It appears verbatim inside map-supplied content-hash expressions and is defined nowhere in this project or in either original. The expressions are not rewritten, because a tidied key is a different key.

known_open_items.item: the central-view rule is written nowhere in the repository
known_open_items.detail: It was implemented once, in gen 1's 43 stitched views, and never written down -- which is why every build after gen 1 drifted away from it. It is now recorded verbatim in build_profile.json -> central_view_rule.
